   'sqx':np.sqrt(x),'sqv':np.sqrt(v),'tanhv':np.tanh(v),'vabsv':v*np.abs(v),'x2v':x*x*v,'xv2':x*v*v}
G={'1':one,'C':None,'S':None}
def lib(w):
    d={}
    for k_,f in F.items(): d[k_]=f
    d['1']=one
    for k_,f in F.items():
        d['C*'+k_]=np.cos(w*t)*f
        d['S*'+k_]=np.sin(w*t)*f
    d['C']=np.cos(w*t); d['S']=np.sin(w*t)
    return d
def fitL(w):
    d=lib(w); keys=list(d); X=np.column_stack([d[k_] for k_ in keys])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dv_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt),keys,c
